intervention: Change only weight on auxiliary sprite-location cross-entropy from 0 to 0.15. Native x/y are strictly a supervised training target; both deployed policies accept the same two-channel camera and emit identical action head shapes. Same initial weights, player splits, random permutations and augmentations.
rationale: Frozen player readout at 9000 SFT steps gave higher median sprite-position error than the original encoder on five of six held Stage1 pilots. Test whether a joint loss preserves the representation and changes human action imitation.
endpoints: Held-player movement NLL, move changes, exact human Bomb-key onset precision and player localization. Inspect original credits separately from offline metrics.
